description: Exelon Corporation is a utility services holding company engaged in the energy transmission and distribution businesses through its subsidiaries, ComEd, PECO, BGE, Pepco, DPL and ACE, which purchase and sell electricity and natural gas and transmit and distribute electricity and natural gas to retail customers across northern Illinois including the City of Chicago, southeastern Pennsylvania including the City of Philadelphia, central Maryland including the City of Baltimore, portions of Delaware and Maryland, the District of Columbia and major portions of Montgomery and Prince George's Counties, Maryland, and portions of southern New Jersey.
